title: [spec-gap][R-GATT-003] SenML canonical-unit conversion (K.5) absent: no mmHg-to-Pa, F-to-Cel, lbs-to-kg, mg/dL-to-kg/L, mph-to-m/s converters in any stack
description: Requirement (K.5 MUST): Gateways MUST convert to SenML canonical units before transmission, per the 10-row conversion table (mmHg x133.322 -> Pa; (F-32)x5/9 -> Cel; mg/dL x1e-5 -> kg/L; lbs x0.453592 -> kg; feet x0.3048 -> m; mph x0.44704 -> m/s; rpm/bpm -> /min; centidegrees /100 -> deg; 1/1024 deg /1024 -> deg). Classification: not-implemented. Evidence: rg '133\.322|0\.453592|0\.3048|0\.44704|mmHg|centidegree' across rust/, lichen/, python/src/, firmware/, c/ finds only unrelated compact_cot course_centidegrees (CoT PLI, no GATT relation); python/src/lichen/senml/ and rust/lichen-senml/src/ have no conversion module (units pass through as opaque strings, ipso.py:219 wire.rs Record.unit); C lichen/subsys/lichen/senml/ likewise; no BLE GATT gateway exists to host the conversion (umbrella bead for the relay feature filed separately). Suggested placement: a small unit-conversion module in lichen-senml (Rust) / lichen.senml (Python) / lichen/subsys/lichen/senml (C) with a GATT-unit->SenML-unit table mirroring K.5, plus test vectors in test/vectors/ (hand-derived, offline).
